title: 第17章 又又又家暴第18章 实在受不了
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
赵大柱越想越气，却又不知道该怎么办，他总不能就这样冲进去把王建国暴打一顿吧？
忽然，一阵激烈的争吵声从洋房里传了出来。
“你个臭娘们蹬鼻子上脸是不是，老子给你吃给你喝给你穿给你用，你要什么我就给你买什么，他妈的老子现在碰你一下都不行！”
毫无疑问这正是王建国的吼声。
紧接着，李玉娇带着哭腔的喊叫就从洋房里传出：“我说不让你碰了吗，你总得先洗个澡……”
“老子就不洗澡，你能怎么着！你看看你脖子上戴的身上穿的，哪一样不是老子给你买的，你他妈的还有脸嫌弃老子？”王建国毫不客气的喝骂，骂的那叫一个难听。
婊子、贱货一类的字眼，令门外的赵大柱都快听不下去了。
李玉娇的哭声越来越大，其中似乎还夹杂着痛呼。
看来王建国又对李玉娇动手了。
赵大柱内心不由得生起熊熊烈火，真想闯进去帮李玉娇教训教训王建国这个不要脸的狗东西。
但他只是在心里想想而已，并没有真的付诸实际行动。
毕竟不管怎么说，李玉娇都是王建国的女人，他今晚就算帮了李玉娇也无法从根本上解决问题。
到了明晚，王建国说不定会骂的更脏，打的更狠！
但赵大柱也不是什么都没做，他知道王建国这个家伙最在乎的就是面子，于是他将两只手像喇叭一样放在嘴边并大喊起来。
“大家快来看热闹啊，王建国又家暴他老婆啦！”
“你们都听听王建国说的那些骂人的话，那叫一个难听！”
附近的房屋亮起了盏盏灯光，而王建国的喝骂之声一下子就消失的无影无踪。
砰！
洋房客厅门被人一脚踹开，光着膀子的王建国从里面冲了出来，厉声怒喝：“谁！谁在外边鬼叫，给我滚出来！”
而赵大柱已经溜了。

但赵大柱虽然走了，住在这附近的杏花村村民都被吸引过来了。
那些老头老太太和大叔大婶们一个个都兴致勃勃的围到了王建国家门口，就差拿把瓜子边看边嗑。
“王建国你又家暴你老婆了？”
“这都多少回了……”
“继续啊，停下来干什么，我们来都来了，你俩咋又不闹了？”
“就是啊，总不能让我们白跑一趟吧。”
王建国气的火冒三丈，却找不到始作俑者，只能跟个精神病一样胡乱辱骂，气急败坏的样子要多好笑就有多好笑。
赵大柱躲在远处的一棵树后，看了几眼便笑呵呵的离开了。
但回到家里，赵大柱就笑不出来了，反而感到浑身难受。
王建国有李玉娇这既年轻又漂亮的老婆，却不知道珍惜。
而自己呢？
连个老婆都没有。
这差距真他妈的大。
赵大柱摇头叹气，一脸落寞的上了床，拉过被子躺下。
但他翻来覆去，怎么都睡不着。
content_en:
The more Zhao Dazhu thought about it, the angrier he became, but he didn't know what to do. He couldn't just rush in and beat Wang Jianguo up, right?
Suddenly, a fierce quarrel came from the bungalow.
"You stinky bitch, you're kicking your nose in the face, aren't you? I'll give you food, drink, clothes, and use for you. I'll buy you whatever you want. I can't even touch you now!"
There is no doubt that this is Wang Jianguo's roar.
Immediately afterwards, Li Yujiao's crying voice came from the bungalow: "Did I tell you not to touch me? You have to take a shower first..."
"I won't take a shower, what can you do! Look at what you're wearing around your neck. I didn't buy anything for you. How dare you fucking dislike me?" Wang Jianguo scolded him unceremoniously, and the scolding was unpleasant.
Words like bitch and slut made Zhao Dazhu outside the door almost unable to listen.
Li Yujiao's cries became louder and louder, and they seemed to be mixed with screams of pain.
It seems that Wang Jianguo has taken action against Li Yujiao again.
Zhao Dazhu couldn't help but feel a raging fire in his heart. He really wanted to break in and help Li Yujiao teach this shameless bitch Wang Jianguo a lesson.
But he just thought about it in his mind and didn't actually take any actual actions.
After all, Li Yujiao was Wang Jianguo's woman no matter what. Even if he helped Li Yujiao tonight, he would not be able to fundamentally solve the problem.
Tomorrow night, Wang Jianguo might scold him even more dirty and hit him harder!
But Zhao Dazhu didn't do nothing. He knew that what Wang Jianguo cared about most was face, so he put his hands to his mouth like trumpets and shouted.
"Everyone, come and watch the fun. Wang Jianguo is domestically abusing his wife again!"
"You all listen to those curse words Wang Jianguo said, they are so ugly!"
The lights in the nearby houses lit up, and Wang Jianguo's shouts and curses suddenly disappeared without a trace.
Bang!
The door to the living room of the bungalow was kicked open, and a shirtless Wang Jianguo rushed out, shouting angrily: "Who! Whoever is screaming outside, get out of here!"
And Zhao Dazhu has already escaped.
But even though Zhao Dazhu left, the villagers of Xinghua Village living nearby were attracted.
The old men, old ladies, uncles and aunts all gathered around Wang Jianguo's door with great interest, just taking a handful of melon seeds to look at and eat.
"Wang Jianguo, are you domestically abusing your wife again?"
"How many times has this happened..."
"Go on, why are you stopping? We're already here, why don't you two stop making trouble?"
"That's right, we can't let our trip go in vain."
Wang Jianguo was furious, but he couldn't find the culprit, so he could only abuse him like a mentally ill person, and his angry look was as funny as possible.
Zhao Dazhu hid behind a tree in the distance, took a few glances and left with a smile.
But when he returned home, Zhao Dazhu couldn't laugh anymore, but felt uncomfortable all over.
Wang Jianguo has a young and beautiful wife like Li Yujiao, but he doesn't know how to cherish her.
And what about yourself?
Not even a wife.
The gap is so fucking huge.
Zhao Dazhu shook his head and sighed, went to bed with a lonely look on his face, pulled the quilt and lay down.
But he tossed and turned and couldn't fall asleep.
